text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I rushed the injured Admire Groove to the 
nurse's office.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
choice_data_list: That looks like it hurts pretty badly...
That looks like it hurts pretty badly...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"I should have moved more carefully... It 
was my mistake."
choice_data_list_en: That looks like it hurts pretty bad...
That looks like it hurts a lot...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
If I were to take time off on top of that— 
it would be too terrible to bear...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I'll just get first aid and head right 
back. I have to get back to training—
choice_data_list:
I want you to rest and not push yourself 
for now.

...All right. Let's keep going within 
reasonable limits.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
choice_data_list: 今は無理せず休んでほしい
……わかった。やれる範囲で続けよう
choice_data_list_en: I want you to rest and not push yourself right now.
...All right. Let's keep going as much as we can.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Even though all the other girls are 
moving forward..."
choice_data_list:
If it gets worse, it'll set you back even 
further.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
choice_data_list: ひどくなったら、さらに遅れるよ
choice_data_list_en: If it gets worse, you'll fall even further behind.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...A sound argument. Understood... I will 
comply.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
So――please, don't look at me with those 
eyes.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
choice_data_list:
I'll cover for the delay... so let's take 
a break.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
choice_data_list: 遅れはカバーする……だから休もう
choice_data_list_en: We'll make up for the lost time... so let's rest.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. Please keep your promise... no 
matter what.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Because I want to get stronger...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
As you can see, I can still do light 
exercise while protecting the injury.
choice_data_list:
We'll take it slow and see how it goes, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I know... If I'm stopped here, it'll all 
be for nothing.
choice_data_list: 徐々に様子を見ながらね
choice_data_list_en: Let's take it gradually and see how things go.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll increase the intensity, bit by 
bit. Doing everything I can... with all my 
might...!"
